# orq_vault (Resource)

A vault: a named collection of secrets that factories attach to expose them as environment variables to work items. A vault is owned by one factory (`factory_id`) or by the workspace. Deleting a vault deletes its secrets and is rejected while a factory still has it attached.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A workspace vault shared with selected factories. Omit `shared_factory_ids`
# to share it with every factory.
resource "orq_vault" "staging" {
  display_name       = "Staging credentials"
  description        = "Third-party keys for the staging stack."
  shared_factory_ids = ["fac_01K8EXAMPLEFACTORY0000000"]
}

# A vault owned by a single factory — set `factory_id` instead:
#
# resource "orq_vault" "factory" {
#   display_name = "Factory credentials"
#   factory_id   = "fac_01K8EXAMPLEFACTORY0000000"
# }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) Vault name (1-100 characters), unique within the workspace.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form description (up to 2000 characters).
- `factory_id` (String) Owning factory; only that factory can attach the vault. Omit for a workspace vault. Changing it replaces the vault.
- `shared_factory_ids` (List of String) Factories allowed to attach a workspace vault. Omit to share the vault with every factory; an empty list shares it with none. Cannot be combined with `factory_id`. Removing a factory that still has the vault attached is rejected.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Vault ID assigned by orq.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Vaults are imported by their prefixed id.
terraform import orq_vault.example vault_01K8EXAMPLEVAULT000000000
```
